_note: Curated quotes from baseball-almanac quote pages.

quotes.quote: Age is a case of mind over matter. If you don't mind, it don't matter.
quotes.speaker: Satchel Paige

quotes.quote: How old would you be if you didn't know how old you were?
quotes.speaker: Satchel Paige

quotes.quote: I never threw an illegal pitch. The trouble is, once in a while I toss one that ain't never been seen by this generation.
quotes.speaker: Satchel Paige

quotes.quote: Just take the ball and throw it where you want to. Throw strikes. Home plate don't move.
quotes.speaker: Satchel Paige

quotes.quote: Ain't no man can avoid being born average, but there ain't no man got to be common.
quotes.speaker: Satchel Paige

quotes.quote: Managing is getting paid for home runs someone else hits.
quotes.speaker: Casey Stengel
quotes.cite: The Sports Hall of Fame Encyclopedia

quotes.quote: Can't anybody here play this game?
quotes.speaker: Casey Stengel

quotes.quote: The secret of managing is to keep the guys who hate you away from the guys who are undecided.
quotes.speaker: Casey Stengel

quotes.quote: You got to get twenty-seven outs to win.
quotes.speaker: Casey Stengel

quotes.quote: Been in this game one-hundred years, but I see new ways to lose 'em I never knew existed before.
quotes.speaker: Casey Stengel

quotes.quote: He'd fall in a sewer and come up with a gold watch.
quotes.speaker: Casey Stengel on Yogi Berra

quotes.quote: Nice guys finish last.
quotes.speaker: Leo Durocher

quotes.quote: I don't care if the guy is yellow or black, or if he has stripes like a god-damn zebra. I'm the manager of this team and I say he plays.
quotes.speaker: Leo Durocher, on Jackie Robinson

quotes.quote: Show me a good loser in professional sports, and I'll show you an idiot.
quotes.speaker: Leo Durocher

quotes.quote: If you don't win, you're going to be fired. If you do win, you've only put off the day you're going to be fired.
quotes.speaker: Leo Durocher

quotes.quote: In a year that has been so improbable, the impossible has happened.
quotes.speaker: Vin Scully
quotes.cite: 1988 World Series, Kirk Gibson's home run

quotes.quote: Statistics are used much like a drunk uses a lamp post: for support, not illumination.
quotes.speaker: Vin Scully

quotes.quote: Good is not good when better is expected.
quotes.speaker: Vin Scully

quotes.quote: Baseball is almost the only orderly thing in a very unorderly world. If you get three strikes, even the best lawyer in the world can't get you off.
quotes.speaker: Bill Veeck

quotes.quote: I try not to break the rules, but merely to test their elasticity.
quotes.speaker: Bill Veeck

quotes.quote: This is a game to be savored, not gulped. There's time to discuss everything between pitches or between innings.
quotes.speaker: Bill Veeck

quotes.quote: I have discovered in twenty years of moving around a ballpark, that the knowledge of the game is usually in inverse proportion to the price of the seats.
quotes.speaker: Bill Veeck

quotes.quote: It breaks your heart. It is designed to break your heart.
quotes.speaker: A. Bartlett Giamatti
quotes.cite: The Green Fields of the Mind, November 1977

quotes.quote: On matters of race, on matters of decency, baseball should lead the way.
quotes.speaker: A. Bartlett Giamatti

quotes.quote: People will say I'm an idealist. I hope so.
quotes.speaker: A. Bartlett Giamatti

quotes.quote: Statistics are the lifeblood of baseball.
quotes.speaker: Leonard Koppett
quotes.cite: A Thinking Man's Guide to Baseball, 1967

quotes.quote: A baseball fan has the digestive apparatus of a billy goat. He can, and does, devour any set of statistics with insatiable appetite and then nuzzles hungrily for more.
quotes.speaker: Arthur Daley

quotes.quote: Baseball fans are junkies, and their heroin is the statistic.
quotes.speaker: Robert S. Weider
quotes.cite: In Praise of the Second Season, 1981

quotes.quote: Baseball isn't statistics — baseball is Joe DiMaggio rounding second.
quotes.speaker: Jimmy Breslin

quotes.quote: A passion for statistics is the earmark of a literate people.
quotes.speaker: Paul Fisher

quotes.quote: I really don't care much about baseball, or looking at ball games. All my interest in baseball is in its statistics.
quotes.speaker: Ernest J. Lanigan

quotes.quote: If you dwell on statistics, you get shortsighted. If you aim for consistency, the numbers will be there at the end.
quotes.speaker: Tom Seaver

quotes.quote: They both show a lot, but not everything.
quotes.speaker: Toby Harrah, on statistics and bikinis

quotes.quote: Baseball is probably the world's best documented sport.
quotes.speaker: Ford C. Frick

quotes.quote: Anybody with a pencil could be a statistician back then.
quotes.speaker: Seymour Siwoff, Elias Sports Bureau, on the 19th century
